_source: Ethereum mainnet, read with eth_getLogs / eth_getTransactionByHash. Every value below is on-chain.

aspSet._note: api-dev.0xbow.io/association-set/leaves?chainId=1&entrypoint=0x02a1E0... -- hashes to the root ASPRegistry published

aspOpenings._note: every LabelRegistered(bytes) the staging ASPRegistry has emitted, paired with the value of the deposit in the same transaction. The blobs cannot be decrypted -- only the ASP holds the key -- but their lengths and their leading X25519 point can be checked.

aspSetProduction._note: api-v2.0xbow.io/association-set/leaves?chainId=1&entrypoint=0xca1e0722... -- hashes to the root the production ASPRegistry (0x259C0BEa...) published
